verdict.rationale: Attio documents an official MCP server and says Claude, ChatGPT or other AI tools can search, update and manage the workspace. Its REST API, backed by a published OpenAPI document, covers objects and records, and deals are a standard object, so an agent can write deal stages and fields. Native AI separately picks up buying signals from calls and schedules next steps, but nothing shows email or meeting signals reaching an external agent through the API or MCP. Missing for 10: documented API/MCP access to email and call/meeting data, explicit examples of updating deal stage or next-step fields via MCP, and independent hands-on corroboration.
